members.name: variant
members.doc: DS surface variant. `default` is the elevated overlay panel; `palette` is the full-bleed Agentport terminal palette (set on the root only, flows to Input/List/Group/Separator via context).

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible label for the command menu (cmdk renders it visually hidden).

members.name: shouldFilter
members.doc: Whether cmdk filters + sorts items by the search query. Set `false` to render valid items yourself (server-side / async search).

members.name: loop
members.doc: Loop arrow-key navigation around the ends of the list.

members.name: value
members.doc: Controlled value of the active item (pair with `onValueChange`).

members.doc: Active item value when uncontrolled.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called when the active item changes.

members.name: filter
members.type: (value: string, search: string, keywords?: string[]) => number
members.doc: Custom match function `(value, search, keywords) => number` (0 hidden … 1 best). Defaults to command-score.

members.name: description
members.doc: Visually-hidden dialog description.

members.doc: Extra classes merged onto the inner DialogContent panel.

members.name: showCloseButton
members.doc: Show the dialog's corner close button.

members.name: variant

members.name: shouldFilter
members.doc:
Whether cmdk filters + re-sorts the inner Command by the query. Set `false` for a static/composed
list — a FLAT labeled-separator palette MUST set this, or cmdk's re-sort scrambles items across the
scope-less separators.

members.doc: Open state when uncontrolled.

members.doc: Called with the next open state whenever the palette opens or closes.

members.name: label
members.doc: When set, render the labeled-rule form (an eyebrow caption + hairline) instead of a plain line.

members.name: alwaysRender
members.doc: Keep the separator rendered while the user is filtering (by default it hides during search).

members.name: open

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Open state when uncontrolled — `true` renders the dialog open on mount.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the next open state whenever the dialog opens or closes.

members.name: modal
members.doc: When `true` (default) the overlay blocks pointer events and traps focus; `false` lets the rest of the page stay interactive.

members.name: showCloseButton

members.name: showCloseButton
members.doc: Render a default "Close" button (a DialogClose) at the end of the footer.

members.name: variant
members.doc: Caption style — `legend` (section title) or `label` (control-sized).

members.name: orientation
members.doc:
Layout axis for the stacked Fields — `vertical` stacks them, `horizontal` lays them in a
wrapping row.

members.name: orientation
members.doc:
Flex axis of the row — `vertical` stacks label → control → description; `horizontal` puts
label + control on one row; `responsive` is column on narrow, row at `@md` (container query).

members.name: errors
members.doc:
Validation errors to render (dedup'd; one → text, many → bullet list). Omit when passing
`children`.

members.name: type
members.doc: Native input type — drives the keyboard/affordance. `file` switches to the file picker anatomy.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Hint shown while empty — rendered in the dedicated `input-ink-placeholder` token. Not a label substitute.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Initial value when uncontrolled (the "filled" state).

members.name: value
members.doc: Controlled value (pair with `onChange`).

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Native disabled — blocks interaction and dims the field (`opacity-50`).

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Change handler (required when controlling `value`).

members.name: align
members.doc:
Where the addon sits relative to the control — `inline-start`/`inline-end` beside it,
`block-start`/`block-end` as a toolbar above/below (the group stacks vertically).

members.name: size
members.doc:
Button size on the InputGroup's own scale — `xs`/`sm` text buttons, `icon-xs`/`icon-sm`
icon-only. Mapped onto the DS Button's size + icon flag.

members.name: variant
members.doc:
Surface style — `default` is borderless (sits on the page), `outline` adds a hairline border,
`muted` tints the row with a soft fill.

members.name: size
members.doc: Density — `default` is a comfortable row, `sm` matches it, `xs` is the compact menu-row spacing.

members.name: asChild
members.doc:
Render the styling onto a single child element instead of a `<div>` (Radix Slot) — e.g. wrap an
`<a>` to get a fully clickable link row (adds the `[a]:hover` affordance).

members.name: variant
members.doc:
Media kind — `default` for a bare slot, `icon` sizes a leading glyph, `image` is a fixed-size,
cover-cropped thumbnail/avatar that shrinks with the item `size`.

members.name: emphasis
members.doc:
Keycap weight. `high` is the inverted dark cap (Inverse fill/ink); `low` is the quiet muted cap
(the stock-shadcn look).

members.name: htmlFor
members.doc:
The `id` of the control this label names. Sets the native `for` association — clicking
the label focuses/toggles that control, and it becomes the control's accessible name.
Required for the a11y pairing.

members.doc: Flip/shift the panel to keep it inside the viewport.

members.name: collisionPadding

members.name: sticky
members.doc: Keep the panel attached to the trigger while it is partially scrolled out of view.

members.name: hideWhenDetached
members.doc: Hide the panel when the trigger is fully occluded.

members.name: decorative
members.doc:
Semantic role only, not the look. `true` is non-semantic (`role="none"`, aria-hidden)
for a purely visual divider; `false` exposes the ARIA `separator` role for assistive tech.
